THE HEADLINES:

 

  1. Prime Minister Narendra Modi dedicates to nation India’s first LED Dome Planetarium, COSMOS in Mysuru; Says, Government committed to strengthening India’s research and innovation ecosystem.

  2. Prime Minister flags off Vande Bharat Express between Bengaluru and Madgaon.

  3. India desires a positive, constructive and forward-looking relationship with Bangladesh, says Ministry of External Affairs.

  4. Twenty-three people killed in a road accident near Kaziranga in Assam.

  5. Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal inaugurates 45th India International Trade Fair at Bharat Mandapam in New Delhi.

  6. Four-day Chhath festival begins with ritual of Nahay-Khay.

  7. And, in Badminton, Lakshya Sen progresses to the semifinals of Kumamoto Japan Masters.

 

<><><> 

 

Prime Minister Narendra Modi dedicated to the nation COSMOS-Mysuru, India’s first LED Planetarium and the world’s first tilted LED dome planetarium, at the Jayachamaraja Wadiyar Centre for Higher Learning at the foothills of Chamundi Hills in Mysuru today. Addressing the students the Prime Minister said the traditions of science and spirituality have always grown together in India, where spirituality inspires us to look within and the study of the universe inspires us to look towards the sky.

 

 

The Prime Minister said, Government is committed to strengthening India’s research and innovation ecosystem. He said, the Government has opened up the space sector to the private sector, creating new opportunities for young entrepreneurs. He said, today young entrepreneurs are launching their own rockets and placing satellites into orbit, undertaking experiments never done before in India.

Emphasising the social benefits of India’s space programme, he noted that ISRO’s satellite-based systems support fishermen’s safety and navigation and provide early warnings during natural calamities.

 

Earlier, Prime Minister Modi launched development projects worth over 15,600 crore rupees in Bengaluru, Karnataka today. The projects cover areas of connectivity and energy security. Addressing the gathering, the Prime Minister said improved infrastructure and connectivity create opportunities for employment, industry and economic growth. He noted that 50 crore people have come out of extreme poverty in the country over the past few years.

 

 

The Prime Minister said, the development projects will provide fresh momentum toward building a ‘Developed Karnataka’-andwill reinforce Bengaluru’s identity as a ‘Tech City.’

 

 

Prime Minister Modi also flagged off the Bengaluru-Mangaluru-Madgaon Vande Bharat Express today. The new service will improve connectivity for students, young professionals, entrepreneurs and business travellers, while supporting tourism in Coastal Karnataka and Goa.

 

<><><> 

 

The Ministry of External Affairs has said that India desires a positive, constructive and forward-looking relationship with Bangladesh. To a question on the India-Bangladesh Consular Dialogue during media briefing in New Delhi today, the MEA Spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal said initiatives have been taken and meetings held under structured mechanisms.

 

 

Mr Jaiswal reiterated that the well-being and safety of the Indian seafarers is of high importance to India. He informed that an emergency travel certificate has been issued to Akshay Harish, an Indian seafarer from Keralam who was stranded at Chabahar Port in Iran, for his earliest possible return home. The Indian seafarer has been left stranded in Iran without a passport or travel documents following a series of disruptions involving his shipping vessel, regional conflict, and missing paperwork.     
  
                                                <><><>

In Assam, twenty-three people have been killed in a tragic road accident at Rangajan near Kaziranga today. The accident occurred following a violent collision between a passenger Traveller and an oncoming trailer. The passenger vehicle, heading towards Nagaon, was carrying over thirty-five people. Several passengers have sustained critical injuries and have been rushed for treatment to Jorhat Medical College and Hospital, Bokakhat, and Golaghat.

 

Chief Minister Dr. Himanta Biswa Sarma has expressed profound grief and anguish over the tragic accident saying that the scale of the loss has shaken the entire state. State Cabinet Minister Atul Bora has rushed to the accident site to personally oversee rescue and relief arrangements.

 

Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Home Minister Amit Shah have expressed grief on the tragic road accident. In a social media post, Prime Minister Modi expressed condolences to the bereaved families in this hour of grief. He prayed for the speedy recovery of the injured. Mr Modi announced an ex-gratia of two lakh rupees from PM’s National Relief Fund to the next of kin of each of those killed. The injured will be given 50 thousand rupees.

 

<><><> 

 

Union Minister of Commerce and Industry Piyush Goyal has inaugurated the 45th edition of India International Trade Fair (IITF) at Bharat Mandapam in New Delhi this evening. The annual fair organised by the India Trade Promotion Organisation is commencing from tomorrow. The theme of the fair this year is Vikas aur Virasat. More than 3,500 exhibitors from India and abroad are taking part in the fair. More from our correspondent:

 

 

“The India International Trade Fair (IITF) will witness participation from a total of 32 States and Union Territories. During the 14 day event the participating States and UTs will showcase their regional products, local industries, traditional crafts, culture, tourism potential and development initiatives.International participation includes 11 countries, with pavilions featuring exhibitors from Thailand, Iran, Ghana, Nepal, Afghanistan, the UAE, Turkey, China, Sri Lanka and Bangladesh. More than three thousand five hundred exhibitors from India and abroad will showcase their products and services. With Anupam, Samarth Singh Akashvani News, Delhi.”

 

<><><> 

 

Vice-President C P Radhakrishnan has called for collective efforts by the government, industry and all sections of society to achieve the goal of Viksit Bharat by 2047. The Vice-President said this while addressing the valedictory session of the 31st CII Partnership Summit in Visakhapatnam today. He said India should not merely participate in the emerging global economic order, but play a leading role in shaping it.

 

Addressing the event, Road Transport and Highways Minister Nitin Gadkari said, good road infrastructure and better connectivity were essential for India’s economic growth and global competitiveness. Mr. Gadkari referred to major national projects, including the Atal Tunnel, Zoji La Tunnel and 36 tunnels between Jammu and Srinagar, which, he said, were improving connectivity in difficult areas.

 

 

<><><> 

 

The four-day Chhath festival began today with the ritual of Nahay-Khay. The festival is dedicated to the worship of the Sun God. Chhath songs can be heard across Bihar as people prepare for the festival. Our correspondent reports that the day began with prayers to Sun God. Devotees then had their traditional meal prepared in a satvik manner.

 

 

“Tomorrow, devotees will observe Kharna. After offering prayers and having the Kharna prasad in the evening, they will begin a 36-hour fast without food and water. On November 15, devotees will offer Arghya to the setting Sun. The festival will come to an end on November 16, with prayers to the rising Sun. Preparations for the festival are also in full swing across Bihar. People are busy, with  buying fruits, earthen pots and other items. BJP President Nitin Nabin said Chhath brings new energy and strength. During a visit to Digha Ghat in Patna today, he said the festival reflects Bihar’s culture and traditions. People are visiting Sun temples to offer prayers and seek blessings. Nidhi Shree, Akashvani News, Patna”

 

<><><> 

 

The National Tribal Pride March was ceremonially flagged off today from Ulihatu, in Khunti district of Jharkhand, the birthplace of Bhagwan Birsa Munda, to mark his 151st birth anniversary and Janjatiya Gaurav Diwas. A special report by our Ranchi correspondent on the three-day march paying tribute to the legendary hero who championed the cause of Jal, Jungle and Zameen:

 

 

 

“The soil of Khunti district , which continues to echo the immortal saga of Ulgulan, reverberated once again today with slogans of tribal pride and self-respect. Organised by the BJP’s Scheduled Tribe Morcha, the march was flagged off with a traditional flag by descendants of Bhagwan Birsa Munda himself. The special chariot carrying the statue of Bhagwan Birsa Munda is the main attraction of the march, conveying the message of his struggle and glorious legacy to the people. On the first day, the march will cover a distance of 28 kilometres to reach Khunti. The procession, which began at Ulihatu, will culminate on the 15th of November at Bhagwan Birsa Munda’s memorial in Kokar, Ranchi. Manvish Rahman, Akashvani News, Ranchi”

 

<><><> 

 

In Badminton, Lakshya Sen progressed to the semifinals of the BWF Kumamoto Japan Masters after registering a comfortable straight-games victory over Yushi Tanaka in the quarterfinals today. Lakshya defeated Tanaka of Japan 21-16, 21-15 to seal his place in the last four of the tournament. The Indian shuttler will next face Indonesia’s sixth seed Alwi Farhan in the semifinals tomorrow. However, Kidambi Srikanth bowed out of the tournament after suffering a straight-games defeat to Japan’s Koki Watanabe in the quarterfinals.

 

<><><> 

 

Over 350 players from 24 states will compete in the 82nd National Squash Championship, scheduled to be held at the Otters Club in Mumbai from November 16 to 22. The week-long tournament will feature men’s, women’s and Pro Coach categories, with a total prize purse of 9.6 lakh rupees.

 

<><><> 

 

President Droupadi Murmu conferred the National Sports Awards 2025 today. At a function held at Rashtrapati Bhavan, the President also conferred Tenzing Norgay National Adventure Awards 2024.

 

A total of 17 sportspersons were selected for Arjuna Awards for outstanding performance in Sports and Games for the year 2025. Four Persons including Baljeet Kaur and Rimo Saha were honoured with Tanzing Norgay National Adventure Award 2024.

 

<><><> 

 

India Meteorological Department (IMD) has forecast heavy rainfall over Andaman and Nicobar Islands tomorrow. The Met Department has predicted thunderstorms accompanied by lightning and gusty winds over Jammu Kashmir and Rajasthan during the next two days.

Prime Minister Narendra Modi has said, Agricultural development, smarter farming and farmer empowerment are key to building a Viksit Bharat. Mr Modi made the remarks while addressing Bharat Agriculture Conference in New Delhi this evening. He said, agriculture is India’s culture and tradition.

 

The Prime Minister said, in the last decade the agriculture growth rate in the country has been above four per cent. He said, after Independence it is the first decade when country’s agriculture sector has got such growth rate. We now take you live to listen to the Prime Minister’s address.

 

Around 2,000 farmers from across India, alongside policymakers, diplomats, industry leaders, and agricultural scientists are attending the two-day event.

 

<><><> 

 

Earlier in the day, Prime Minister Modi addressed the Diwali Milan programme at the BJP headquarters in Delhi. Speaking at the event, Mr Modi said, India has set a target of becoming a developed nation by 2047. He said, everyone must work together to make India a developed nation before the country completes 100 years of independence. Speaking about the achievements of recent years, the Prime Minister highlighted that India made history by successfully landing near the Moon’s south pole.

 

<><><> 

 

Defence Minister Rajnath Singh has called upon the armed forces to strengthen both offensive and defensive capabilities, with a focus on maintaining the element of surprise. He said this is essential to ensure operational readiness against conventional and emerging threats. Mr Singh was addressing the Air Force Commanders’ Conference in New Delhi today. We have a report:

 

“Addressing the conference, the Defence Minister stated that the country’s intelligence and surveillance mechanisms must be further strengthened to ensure that the personnel remain alert, agile and equipped to respond effectively to any emerging challenge. Mr Singh  asserted that contemporary conflicts are extending beyond traditional battlefields into non-contact domains, with missiles, drones and advanced weapon systems playing a significant role.  Mr Singh called upon the Indian Air Force to develop dedicated doctrines and architectures for emerging domains of warfare, including electronic, cyber and space. He commended the force for effectively implementing its doctrines and operational methods during and after Operation Sindoor. He appreciated the professionalism, restraint and judgement demonstrated by the air warriors in successfully executing their assigned tasks. On the occasion, the Defence Minister also launched a suite of Artificial Intelligence applications developed in-house by the Indian Air Force’s Al Centre of Excellence of the Unit for Digitisation, Automation, Artificial Intelligence and Application Networking.  SHIVANG MISRA, AKASHAVANI NEWS, DELHI.”

 

<><><> 

 

Union Home Minister Amit Shah today held a review meeting on law and order and policing at the Delhi Police Headquarters in the national capital. Delhi Lieutenant Governor Taranjit Singh Sandhu and senior Delhi Police officials were present on the occasion.

 

<><><> 

 

Prime Minister Narendra Modi will undertake a two-day visit to the Philippines from the 16th of this month. During his visit, Mr Modi will attend the 23rd ASEAN-India Summit and the 21st East Asia Summit in Manila. Briefing the media in New Delhi, Secretary (East) in the External Affairs Ministry, Rudrendra Tandon, said India attaches great importance to its engagement with ASEAN.

 

<><><> 

 

President Droupadi Murmu today said, the country is moving forward towards achieving the goal of Viksit Bharat by 2047. She emphasised that the development of every region and every section of society is essential to achieving this goal. The President was addressing a group of meritorious students from Eklavya Model Residential Schools at Rashtrapati Bhavan. She stressed that students need the right opportunities, a conducive environment and proper guidance to realise their potential.

 

<><><> 

 

Union Tribal Affairs Minister Jual Oram has said, Prime Minister Narendra Modi will join the Janjatiya Gaurav Divas celebrations in Maharashtra through video conferencing on Sunday to mark the 151st birth anniversary of Bhagwan Birsa Munda. Addressing media in New Delhi today, Mr Oram said during the event, 246 projects worth two thousand 913 crore rupees will be launched.

 

<><><> 

 

Principal Secretary to the Prime Minister, Dr PK Mishra, today called for recognising farmers as custodians and innovators of India’s agricultural biodiversity. He stressed the need to link their traditional knowledge with scientific research and seed systems. Dr Mishra was addressing the 22nd Foundation Day of the Protection of Plant Varieties and Farmers’ Rights Authority and the Plant Genome Saviour Award Ceremony in New Delhi.

 

<><><> 

 

In Keralam, the draft electoral roll prepared under the Special Summary Revision  was published today. A total of two crore 73 lakh 60 thousand 254 voters have been included in the draft list. Claims and objections to the draft electoral roll can be submitted till 11th of December. The final electoral roll will be published on 4th of January.

 

<><><> 

 

The integrated draft electoral rolls have also been published in all districts of Tamil Nadu at designated locations. Chief Electoral Officer Archana Patnaik said the draft rolls, prepared as part of the Special Summary Revision of Photo Electoral Rolls, include a total of five crore 77 lakh 46 thousand 618 electors across the State. Voters can check their details and submit the required forms for inclusion or correction of their names.

 

<><><> 

 

US President Donald Trump’s envoys, Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner, today met Russian President Vladimir Putin in Moscow. The meeting came a day after the latest round of talks aimed at ending the war in Ukraine concluded in Abu Dhabi. Washington is seeking to give fresh momentum to peace efforts following two days of US-mediated negotiations between Russian and Ukrainian delegations.

 

Witkoff and Kushner, who is also the US President’s son-in-law, had brokered the talks in Abu Dhabi. The negotiations concluded yesterday with an agreement on a major prisoner exchange. However, the exact number of prisoners to be exchanged is yet to be finalised. The talks made no visible breakthrough towards ending the large-scale hostilities, which began on 24th of February in 2022. Witkoff and Kushner went directly to the Kremlin to brief President Putin. The meeting lasted around two hours. They are scheduled to travel to Dublin in Ireland, for talks with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy. Meanwhile, President Zelenskyy has said, Ukraine’s military is once again facing systematic restrictions on access to Starlink’s military-grade services.

 

<><><> 

 

Union Minister for Ports, Shipping and Waterways, Sarbananda Sonowal, has informed that all 19 Indian seafarers aboard the Liberia-flagged crude oil tanker MT Dominica Prosperity are safe following a projectile attack off Mina Saqr yesterday. In a social media post, Mr Sonowal said, the vessel was targeted while drifting off Mina Saqr. He said the UAE Coast Guard swiftly evacuated all 22 crew members safely. The Minister said, the government is in continuous contact with the ship management company to ensure the safety, welfare and necessary logistical support for the crew members.

 

<><><> 

 

Benchmark domestic equity indices ended in a positive zone today. We have a report:

 

“The Sensex rose marginally by 32 points to close at 81 thousand 911. The Nifty added 44 points or 0.2 per cent to settle at 25 thousand 299. In the broader market on the National Stock Exchange, the Midcap 100 index gained 0.9 per cent and the Smallcap 100 index climbed 1.1 per cent. In the forex market today, the rupee depreciated by 35 paise to trade at 94 rupees and four paise against the US dollar.WITH DRISHTI’s Report, NISHIT KUMAR FOR AKASHVANI News.”

In Shooting, India’s Vivaan Kapoor has won the silver medal in the men’s trap event at the ISSF World Championships in Doha today. He has also secured a quota place for India at the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics. Earlier, Jaypal Malviya in men’s 10-metre air pistol and Niraj Kumar in men’s 50-metre rifle three positions had secured the Olympic quota places.

 

<><><> 

 

In Men’s ODI Cricket, India have set up a title clash with Pakistan in the Under-19 Asia Cup. The Men in Blue defeated Afghanistan by eight wickets in the second semi-final in Oman today. Chasing a target of 228 runs, India comfortably reached 230 for two in just 36.5 overs. Captain Lakshya Rajesh Raichandani led the chase with an impressive 93 runs. Earlier, Afghanistan, batting first, scored 227 runs for the loss of eight wickets in their allotted 50 overs. India will face arch-rivals Pakistan in the final on Saturday.

 


Earlier in the first semi-final, Pakistan defeated Bangladesh by nine wickets to book their place in the summit clash.

The India Meteorological Department (IMD) has forecast heavy rainfall over Andaman and Nicobar Islands tomorrow. The Met Department has also predicted thunderstorms accompanied with lightning over Himachal Pradesh during the next two days.

Government has approved the Nutrient Based Subsidy rates for RABI Season, 2026-27 on Phosphatic and Potassic fertilizers. The tentative budgetary requirement for Rabi 2026-27 will be approximately 62 thousand 370 crore rupees. This is nearly 24 thousand 417 crore more than the budgetary requirement for Rabi 2025-26 season. Briefing media in New Delhi today after the Union Cabinet meeting, Information and Broadcasting Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw said the subsidy will ensure smooth availability of these fertilizers to the farmers at affordable prices. Mr. Vaishnaw said, the Cabinet has approved the continuation of Credit Guarantee Fund for Micro Units under Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana for a period of five years upto 31st of March 2031. He said that the outlay of five thousand crore rupees is approved for guarantee and it is expected to support mudra loans worth 12.60 lakh crore rupees.

 

The Cabinet has also given nod to the continuation of Stand-Up India Scheme for a period of five years upto 31st of March 2031. The scheme aims to promote entrepreneurship among Women, Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes and aims to provide financial assistance to additional 2.5 lakh entrepreneurs in a span of five years.

 

The Cabinet has also cleared the extension of Aqua Line Metro Rail Corridor from Noida Sector-51 to Greater Noida Sector-04 of Noida Metro Rail Project covering approximately 8.5 kilometres and comprising five elevated stations.

 

The Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs has approved the development of the Yuge Yugeen Bharat Museum at the North and South Block Complex, New Delhi. Mr. Vaishnaw said, the Museum is envisaged as a landmark civilizational museum showcasing the continuity, diversity and richness of Bharat’s civilizational heritage through an integrated narrative of its tangible and intangible cultural heritage.

The Ministry of Defence has signed a contract worth over 498 crore rupees with Cochin Shipyard Limited for the Normal Refit and Re-powering of Indian Naval Ship, Betwa. The contract was inked in the presence of Defence Secretary Rajesh Kumar Singh in New Delhi today.

 

The Defence Ministry said that under the contract, INS Betwa, a Brahmaputra-class frigate of the Indian Navy, will undergo a major propulsion system transformation.

           

The Ministry said that the project will provide a major impetus to the Government’s vision of ‘Aatmanirbhar Bharat’ and ‘Make-in-India’, while reinforcing the country’s indigenous naval ship repair and maintenance capabilities.

 

<><><> 

 

President Droupadi Murmu has said that the goal of cleanliness cannot be achieved through the efforts of any single institution alone and the participation of every citizen, every household, every community and every city is essential. Speaking after presenting Swachh Survekshan Awards 2025-26 in New Delhi this evening, the President said, cleanliness is not merely a matter of maintaining the appearance of public spaces but it reflects health of citizens, social sensitivity and administrative accountability.

 

In his address, Housing and Urban Affairs Minister Manohar Lal said, with the beginning of Swachh Bharat Mission in 2014, cleanliness has become a mass celebration.

 

More from our correspondent:

 

“Swachh Survekshan has grown in scale from 73 ULBs in 2016 to over four thousand 751 cities in its latest edition. In Swachh Shehar Jodi category the 1st prize was presented to Ahmedabad and Sanand in Gujarat, the 2nd prize was given to Indore and Depalpur in Madhya Pradesh. 3rd Prize was presented to Tirupati and Kuppam in Andhra Pradesh. Swachh Sheher League award was given to Navi Mumbai, Surat and Vijaywada. GVMC Vishakhapatnam, Jabalpur and Lucknow were awarded as top three cities for cleanliness in more than 10 lakh population category. Rewa in Madhya Pradesh, Bilaspur in Chhatisgarh and Varanasi in Uttar Pradesh were presented awards as Swachh river front towns. Puri in Odisha got the 1st prize as Swachh Coastal Town and Rudrapur in Uttarakhand got 1st prize as Clean Himalayan city. The awards serve as a celebration of the collective achievements of cities and States in the past decade and a renewed commitment to sustain on-ground achievements. With Anand Kumar, Anupam Mishra, Akashvani News, Delhi.”

Northern Railway has made elaborate arrangements at major stations of Delhi Area for the convenience of passengers, especially those travelling to the Eastern parts of the country to celebrate the festival of Chhath. The Northern Railway is operating 31 Special trains from major railway stations in the Delhi region today. The move is aimed at facilitating passengers travelling to their native places to celebrate the festival. Tomorrow, the Railways will operate 29 special trains from the Delhi region.

 

<><><> 

 

External Affairs Minister Dr S Jaishankar and West Bengal Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari today launched the Pravasi Bharatiya Diwas website in New Delhi. The 19th Pravasi Bharatiya Diwas Convention will be held from 7 to 9th January next year in Kolkata. The theme: is “Return to Roots: Reigniting the Diaspora Connect with Bharat”. The Convention will be organized by the Ministry of External Affairs in partnership with the State Government of West Bengal. 

 

<><><> 

 

India has offered to share its healthcare expertise, technical capabilities and best practices with fellow BIMSTEC member countries, emphasizing its commitment to strengthening regional cooperation in the health sector. Union Health Minister J.P. Nadda made the offer while addressing the inaugural BIMSTEC Health Ministers’ Meeting in Colombo, the first such gathering of health ministers and senior representatives from India, Sri Lanka, Bangladesh, Bhutan, Myanmar, Nepal and Thailand.

 

<><><> 

 

Moody’s Ratings has raised India’s GDP growth forecast to 7 per cent for the current fiscal year from its earlier projections of 6.5 per cent, citing strong domestic consumption, improving investment and the economy’s resilience to higher global energy prices.

 

In its Global Macro Outlook 2027-28 report, the ratings agency said India’s economic growth is expected to remain near seven per cent over the medium term, with sustained private investment potentially pushing growth even higher. Moody’s also pointed to stronger capital goods production and imports, faster industrial credit growth and improving capacity utilisation as signs of a recovery in private investment.

 

It noted that the country has handled the global energy price shock better than previously expected, helped by its ability to diversify crude oil and gas supplies.

Benchmark domestic equity indices closed nearly one per cent higher today. We have a report:

 

“The Sensex rose 773 points to close at 81 thousand 879. The Nifty gained 210 points to settle at 25 thousand 255. In the broader market on the National Stock Exchange, the Midcap 100 index added 0.8 per cent and the Smallcap 100 index rose 1.6 per cent. In the forex market today, the rupee appreciated by 25 paise to trade at 93 rupees and 69 paise against the US dollar.WITH DRISHTI’s Report, SARABJEET KAURFOR AKASHVANI News.”

Russia and Ukraine have agreed in principle to a major prisoner-of-war exchange following two days of US-mediated negotiations in Abu Dhabi, although no breakthrough was reached on ending the nearly five-year conflict.

 

US special envoy Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner described the trilateral talks as difficult but productive. Kushner said the agreement could lead to the biggest humanitarian release of prisoners since the war began, with final numbers expected to be confirmed shortly. Vladimir Medinsky, head of the Russian delegation at talks, told a press conference that details of the exchange would be announced soon and that negotiations would continue.

 

Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy welcomed the progress but insisted that European countries must be involved in negotiations concerning the continent’s security.

 

Washington has indicated support for European participation, particularly on security guarantees, while Moscow has questioned the need for European representatives in direct negotiations, arguing that their support for Ukraine makes them unsuitable as neutral participants.

The India Meteorological Department (IMD) has forecast heavy rainfall over Andaman and Nicobar Islands and Jammu and Kashmir, Ladakh and Muzaffarabad tomorrow. The Met Department has also predicted thunderstorms accompanied with lightning over Keralam, Mahe, Tamil Nadu, Puducherry  and Karaikal for tomorrow. Similar conditions are expected over Jammu and Kashmir, Ladakh and Muzaffarabad for the next two days.

The portals of Shri Kedarnath and Shri Yamunotri temples in Uttarakhand were closed for the winter season today on the occasion of Bhai Dooj, following traditional rituals and Vedic chanting. With this, the annual pilgrimage to both shrines has come to an end.

Niraj Kumar today won the bronze medal in the men’s 50 metre rifle three-positions event at the World Shooting Championships in Doha. Niraj has also secured a quota place for the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics.

 

This marks India’s second Olympic quota from the championships. Previously, Jaypal Malviya had secured the first quota by winning a silver medal in the men’s 10m air pistol event.

In Football, India today defeated Maldives 1-nil in SAFF Championship Group B match at the National Stadium in Dhaka. Suhail Ahmad Bhat scored the match’s lone goal from the penalty spot in the 38th minute. With this the Blue Tigers entered the semi-finals.

The Delhi Government has notified the Delhi (Right of Citizens to Time-Bound and Easy Delivery of Services) Act, 2026. The Act aims to ensure that government departments deliver services within prescribed timelines and officials responsible for unnecessary delays are held accountable. It will replace the existing time-bound service delivery law of 2011 with a more modern and accountable system. Delhi Chief Minister Rekha Gupta said that the government is committed to making Delhi’s governance system citizen-centric, responsive and accountable, ensuring that every eligible citizen receives services on time and without difficulty. More from our correspondent

 

 

 

         

 

“The new system will ensure that citizens do not have to wait indefinitely for government services as the citizens will have a statutory right to receive government services within a prescribed timeframe. For unnecessary delays in delivery of services, the concerned officer can be fined 250 rupees per day, up to a maximum of five thousand rupees. There is also a provision for a fine for improperly rejecting applications under the new framework. Once an application is received, the designated officer will be responsible for either delivering the service within the prescribed timeline or communicating the reason for its rejection in writing. The Delhi government said that every application will be assigned a unique application number, allowing applicants to track its status online.  WITH ANAND KUMAR , SHIVANG MISRA, AKASHVANI NEWS, DELHI.”

Indian stock and commodity markets held a special Muhurat Trading session on Diwali, marking the beginning of Samvat 2083. The benchmark indices, Sensex and Nifty, erased their early gains and closed in the red during the special Diwali trading session. The Sensex declined around 29 points, while the Nifty slipped 44 points to end the session lower. The markets had opened on a positive note but witnessed selling pressure towards the close, ending the first trading session of Samvat 2083 on a subdued note.

 

 

However, The Indian stock markets have recorded a strong seven-day pre-Diwali rally, with both the benchmark indices surging over 10 per cent in the run-up to the festival.

 

 

The Sensex rallied past the 81,000-mark, gaining 10.6 per cent, while the Nifty crossed the 25,000-mark, up by nearly 10.3 per cent in the seven trading sessions preceding Diwali.

 

 

National Stock Exchange MD and CEO Ashish Kumar Chauhan expressed optimism about the Indian economy, citing its strong fundamentals and growth prospects despite global uncertainties.

The Government has said that the revised prices of 137 anti-cancer drugs will come into effect from Monday. Recently, the National Pharmaceutical Pricing Authority had capped trade margins on Maximum Retail Price (MRP) of these anti-cancer drugs. We have a Report :-

“The Ministry of Chemicals and Fertilizers informed that as on date, 76 pharmaceutical companies have reported revised MRP for one thousand and two hundred twenty five anti-cancer formulations, covering 121 drugs.It added that the reduction in the MRP have been reported in over one thousand formulations of anti-cancer medicines with 600 brands reporting above 50 per cent reduction and the highest reduction being 96.45 per cent. The Ministry said that as a result of the price reductions the estimated annual savings to consumers would be more than three thousand five hundred crore rupees. It also said that every retailer, dealer, hospital and institution is required to prominently display revised MRP list of anti-cancer medicines on their websites and in their premises. With Anand, Samarth Singh, Akashvani News, Delhi.”

Union Home Minister Amit Shah chaired a high-level review meeting in Ahmedabad today and held extensive discussions on multiple facets of state and national security. He reviewed progress on key issues including border and coastal security, narcotics control, cybercrime, and disaster management. Topics like the Citizenship Amendment Act, the upcoming census, and the Agniveer scheme were also discussed. Mr Shah also assessed the law and order and citizen security situation in Gujarat ahead of Diwali. It was attended by Chief Minister Bhupendra Patel, Minister of State for Home Harsh Sanghavi, and senior officials from the Union Home Ministry, the State Home Department, and various security agencies.

Stressing the urgency of tackling the drug menace, the Union Home Minister urged officials to work towards achieving the goal of a ‘Nasha Mukt Bharat’ by 2029.

The President also appealed to the youth to contribute in building a Viksit Bharat.

Union Minister for Railways Ashwini Vaishnaw today reviewed the functioning of War Room providing live visual feeds from railway stations, covering critical areas such as platforms, foot-over bridges and station surroundings. In Yemen, 25 people were killed and 30 others injured after airstrikes hit a market in southwestern Taiz province of the country today. Houthi Health Ministry spokesperson Anees Alsabahi confirmed the casualties in a post on X, saying the strikes targeted a market in the al-Waziyah district. The Saudi-backed Yemeni military and Houthi rebels have traded accusations over responsibility for the deadly attack.

Meanwhile, Saudi Arabia’s Information Ministry did not immediately respond to requests for comment.

The latest attack comes amid renewed hostilities in Yemen. Taiz province is largely under Houthi control, while the rebels have maintained a siege around the provincial capital, where the Saudi-backed government and its forces are based.
